help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How Legatio keeps you in control

steps.title: Create your agent
steps.body: From Dashboard or Agents — this is who negotiates for you.

steps.title: Define rules
steps.body: New constitution → templates → save and activate.

steps.title: Negotiate
steps.body: Start a room, process rounds, watch proposals and outcomes.

steps.title: Decide when asked
steps.body: Approvals badge in the menu means Legatio needs you.

faqs.a: Usually the constitution had no matching rules (or no rules at all). Add an approval threshold and activate.

faqs.q: Do I need JSON or code?
faqs.a: No. Use the constitution form templates and only edit the number.

faqs.q: What if I never open Approvals?
faqs.a: Actions that require your OK stay blocked. That is intentional.
In this MVP counterparties are simulated so you can test the full control loop safely.

help.rulesIntro: Rules look at proposal fields (like amount). Matching DENY blocks. Matching REQUIRE_APPROVAL waits for you. Otherwise ALLOW.
help.rulesHowToBody: Dashboard checklist → create agent → new constitution → use templates → save and activate → negotiate → process rounds → open Approvals if asked.
help.rulesExampleBody: Template “Ask my OK if amount > X” with value 200. Simulated offers of 600–800 will pause for you.
help.rulesActions: Prefer human OK for grey zones; hard DENY for absolute limits (privacy, extreme amounts).
help.rulesTip: Never leave a constitution with zero rules if you care about control — empty means almost everything is allowed.
help.promiseBody: Legatio is not the agent that books hotels or renews subscriptions by itself. It is the trust layer: you define rules, agents propose, policy decides allow / deny / ask you, and everything is audited.

glossary.meaning: A party in a negotiation. Yours is “your agent”; counterparties may be simulated in the MVP.
The rule pack attached to your agent. Must be Active to negotiate.
An offer in a round (amount, type, etc.) evaluated by policy.
A pause for your explicit yes/no when a rule requires it.
Signed outcome and immutable history of what happened.

home.headline: Humans stay in control when agents negotiate
home.lead: Legatio lets you define rules, run multi-round negotiations, require human approval when risk is high, and keep a verifiable audit trail.

pillars.title: Constitutions
pillars.body: Policy rules your agents must obey: budgets, privacy, auto-renewal limits.

pillars.title: Negotiations
pillars.body: Structured rounds between your agent and external parties with clear outcomes.

pillars.title: Human-in-the-loop
pillars.body: High-risk proposals pause for approval. Agreements and audit close the loop.

flow.title: Negotiate

flow.title: Record
flow.body: Sign agreements and inspect the audit chain.

home.bottomTitle: Built for demos and real control
home.bottomBody: Start with seed data or create your own agent in seconds. English and Spanish UI, light and dark themes.
